tagline: A more thoughtful way to explore Kyoto, one step at a time.
welcomeBody: Discover a future walking experience shaped around curiosity, local places, and respect for the city.
nicknameHint: Saved only on this device. You can change it later.
homeBody: Explore three map-checked Kyoto walks, with honest access notes and optional GPS or Demo Mode.
homeValueTitle: A gentler way through the city
homeValueBody: Three map-checked walks now show public corridors, nearby places, and access considerations.
homeComingBody: Map-linked place cards and sample congestion cues come next; check-ins and rewards follow later.
mapBody: Explore Kyoto on a real, interactive map. Choose live GPS or a simulated Kyoto point.
mapExploreHint: Drag to explore Kyoto. Pinch or use +/− to zoom.
mapLoadError: The map could not load. Check your connection or browser graphics support, then reload.
mapSearchPreviewBody: Choose a mapped walk or search a place name.
mapSearchNoResults: No mapped walk matches that search. Try Yasaka, river, or Maruyama.
mapCategoryPreviewBody: Choose another theme. Themes without a validated walk show an empty state.
mapSampleLocationLabel: Sample map point, not your GPS location
mapIntroBody: Choose one of three map-checked walks. Check-ins and rewards are not active.
mapRoutePreviewBody: Choose from three map-checked walks. Check-ins and rewards are not active.
mapListPreviewBody: The walk list shows verified places and access notes.
mapCanvasCaption: Real geography and room to wander.
rewardsBody: Demo coins and example coupons are planned for a later phase. There are no redeemable rewards in this build.
rewardsStatus: Demo rewards are not active yet
missionsTitle: Every walk can tell a story.
missionsBody: The future mission board will collect themed walks and stamps. Check-ins are not active in Phase 0.
settingsBody: Your name and language stay on this device.
aboutBody: Kyoto AI Lab prototype offers three map-checked walks and opt-in browser GPS. Demo Mode uses a separate simulated point. GPS stops when you leave Map. Routes are not field-audited; check-ins, missions, and rewards are not active. No account or location history is collected by this app.
onboardingReturn: Your welcome screen is saved locally.
locationStatusOff: No location selected. Choose GPS or Demo Mode.
locationStatusDemo: Simulated point near Gion-Shijo. GPS is off.
locationStatusRequesting: Waiting for browser location permission and a fix…

locationStatusOutsideKyoto: Outside Kyoto. Your actual location is shown (±{accuracy} m).
locationStatusDenied: Location permission denied. Retry or use Demo Mode.
locationStatusTimeout: Location timed out. Retry or use Demo Mode.
locationStatusUnavailable: Location unavailable. Check browser support and HTTPS.
locationStatusPaused: GPS stopped outside Map. Tap Use My Location to resume.
mapDemoMarkerLabel: Simulated Kyoto location, not your GPS position
locationSettingsHint: Turning Demo Mode off keeps GPS off. Recenter opens Map; paused live GPS needs a new Use My Location tap.
